faqs.q: Will I get 1.5% cashback on all transactions?
faqs.a: No, some transactions are not eligible for any cashback accrual. These include fuel spends, EMI transactions, purchases converted to EMI, wallet loading transactions, cash advances, payment of outstanding balances and payment of card fees and other card charges. Moreover, utility bill payments, DTH and mobile recharges paid via any other platform except Google Pay will also not earn any cashback.

faqs.q: Are all purchases on Google Pay rewarded with 5% cashback?
faqs.a: No, bill payments, mobile and DTH recharges are rewarded with 5% cashback. Note that the ‘pay with card’ feature for bill payments is available only for Android users. The facility is not available on iOS, which means iPhone users would not be able to maximize the value-back that Axis Ace offers.

faqs.q: Which transactions can I convert into EMI?
faqs.a: Transactions that are over Rs. 2,500 can be converted into EMI post-purchase.

faqs.q: Does Axis Ace Credit Card offer any airport lounge access?
faqs.a: Axis Bank Ace Credit Card users can visit and avail up to 4 free visits to the participating domestic airport lounges every year. Visit the official bank website for the detailed and updated list of eligible lounges. However, this free lounge access is only available if you spend a minimum of Rs. 50,000 during the previous 3 months.

faqs.q: Does Axis Bank provide a discount on chain restaurants or franchises, such as KFC?
faqs.a: Yes, the list of partner restaurants includes franchises, such as KFC, TGI Fridays, Tossin Pizza, Chicago Pizza and so on.

faqs.q: What is the Axis Ace credit card cashback limit?
faqs.a: Axis Ace credit card comes with a combined monthly capping limit of Rs. 500 on the cashback earnings on 5% and 4% cashback categories.

faqs.q: How can I apply for the Axis Bank Ace Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can apply for Axis Ace Credit Card online either through the Issuer / Market platform by filling your details in the form given on this page or through the official Axis bank website.

faqs.question: Is the Axis Ace Credit Card worth it?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Axis Ace Credit Card is still a good cashback card for utility bill payments through Google Pay and everyday spending. It also offers unlimited 1.5% cashback on most eligible transactions.

faqs.question: What is the annual fee of the Axis Ace Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The card charges an annual fee of ₹499 plus GST. The fee is waived if you spend ₹2 lakh or more in a card anniversary year.

faqs.question: How much cashback does Axis Ace offer?
faqs.answer: You earn 5% cashback on utility bill payments via Google Pay, 4% cashback on Swiggy, Zomato, and Ola, and 1.5% cashback on most other eligible spends.

program_updates_2026: The Axis Ace Credit Card is no longer the cashback powerhouse it was when it launched. Multiple devaluations, cashback caps, and spending exclusions have reduced some of its appeal.
